description: Configure GitHub Actions workflow for current Tauri Android project to automatically generate ARM architecture APK files for user download when code is pushed to repository.

userStories.title: Developer auto-build APK on push/PR to main
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to automatically trigger Android APK build when pushing to main branch or creating PR to main, so that I can quickly verify if code changes affect Android build and get latest APK for testing.
acceptanceCriteria: Push to main branch triggers GitHub Actions workflow
PR to main branch triggers GitHub Actions workflow
Build uses Ubuntu environment with Node.js 20.x, Java JDK 17, Android SDK (build-tools 36.0.0, platforms android-36)
Build installs Rust toolchain with aarch64-linux-android and armv7-linux-androideabi targets
Build runs npm ci to install dependencies
Build initializes Tauri Android project with npx tauri android init --ci
Build creates ARM64 APK with npx tauri android build --target aarch64 --apk
Build creates ARMv7 APK with npx tauri android build --target armv7 --apk
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser
userStories.notes: Added typecheck and lint steps to workflow. Fixed lint issues by ignoring src-tauri/target in eslint config and fixing unused import in test-playback.ts.

userStories.title: User downloads APK from Actions page
userStories.description: As a user, I want to download latest built APK directly from GitHub Actions page, so that I can install and test latest features without waiting for official release.
acceptanceCriteria: ARM64 APK uploaded as GitHub Actions artifact with name 'miyako-arm64-apk'
ARMv7 APK uploaded as GitHub Actions artifact with name 'miyako-armv7-apk'
Artifacts retained for 30 days
Build summary in GitHub Actions provides download instructions
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser

userStories.title: Developer manually triggers build
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to be able to manually trigger a build (workflow_dispatch), so that I can rebuild APK when needed (e.g., after dependency updates).
acceptanceCriteria: workflow_dispatch trigger option available in GitHub Actions
Manual trigger initiates same build process as push/PR triggers
Manual trigger allows selecting branch to build from
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser

userStories.title: User downloads stable APK from Releases page
userStories.description: As a user, I want to download stable version APK from Releases page when project releases new tag, so that I can get verified stable version.
acceptanceCriteria: When pushing tag, automatically creates GitHub Release
ARM64 APK uploaded to Release as 'miyako-arm64.apk'
ARMv7 APK uploaded to Release as 'miyako-armv7.apk'
Release is non-draft, non-prerelease
Build summary provides installation commands for APKs
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser
